source_notes: Agent-authored online private-text-chat draft concepts and RU/EN/TR draft localizations; limited to mutually chosen text exchange between the pair, without attachments, recording, screenshots, proof, contact, going away or disclosure of private data. Requires private_text_chat capability. No external card collection used. Human originality, rights, safety, cultural suitability, similarity, diversity and tri-locale review NOT performed; not approved or publishable.
